description: Entrance to a peaceful marina in village of Lage-Zwaluwe in the Netherlands. Sometimes a boat passes by. Because the wind is somewhat gusty, you can sometimes hear the rigging hitting the masts. The boat's waves make other boats shake and make noise. More this morning / More recordings in marina’s Date/time: August 7, 2024, 12:22 PM Weather: 20c, clouds 90-70%, wind SW 7-13 km/h, 1013 hPa, humidity 86%, visibility 18 km, dew point 18c Location; polder Ameroever, Lage-Zwaluwe, Noord-Brabant, Netherlands (Holland), Europe. GPS 51.71597 4.69384 Gear chain: Sennheiser mkh30/50 MS with pointed NE 55 degree, in Rycote cyclone small, windjammer > Sound Devices 302 >Tascam dr-100 Mk2. N. Decoded Mid-side to STEREO.
